title: Herbal Velvety Saudi Arabian Beef Stew
description: A fragrant, slow‑cooked beef shin stew infused with aromatic herbs and warm spices, finished with a velvety broth perfect for meal‑prep. It’s paleo‑friendly, gluten‑free, and low‑carb.

ingredients.name: Beef shin, bone‑in, cut into 2–3 cm cubes
Fresh herb mix (parsley, cilantro, mint, oregano), chopped

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium‑high heat. Add the beef cubes and brown on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, and sumac to the pot, stirring to coat the meat and toast the spices for 2 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth and add the cauliflower florets. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 70 minutes, until the beef is tender.
Stir in the chopped fresh herb mix and cook for an additional 5 minutes to meld the flavors.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or sumac if needed. Serve hot or let cool for meal‑prep portions. If desired, finish with a squeeze of lemon juice for brightness.
